_comment: Shared engine + gate examples for bulk packs (feedback-1001-names-units D33/D34, plan-review F1/F4/F9). Read by BOTH supply-os-v1/tests/test_case_suggestion_fixture.py (compute_suggestion + _evaluate_submit_line) and frontend/src/pages/captain-mp/lib/caseSuggestionFixture.test.ts (computeSuggestion + computeRowState), so a drift between the two engines fails on both sides. Quantities are purchase units; an item row is merged with the row's item_overrides. 'delta' is the stored delta_vs_suggestion_pct (a fraction; the frontend's signed deviationPct / 100 in absolute value); null = not compared (uncounted line, or need 0 where the backend stores None).
